# LLNL/open-ai-co-scientist — source dossier

**Scope:** M4 source assessment. No upstream setup script, agent workflow, dependency install, or inference was run.

## Pinned source and license

- Upstream: [llnl/open-ai-co-scientist](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist), pinned at [`c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258`](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/commit/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258). The upstream default branch was `main` when acquired.
- Acquisition working copy: `references/work/llnl-open-ai-co-scientist/`, detached at the pinned commit, verified clean, and removed after release.
- Root [LICENSE](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/LICENSE) is MIT, copyright 2025 Lawrence Livermore National Security, LLC. The root [NOTICE](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/NOTICE) carries DOE sponsorship and non-endorsement language. No nested license, vendored code, or submodule is tracked; listed Python dependencies retain their own terms. No source code has been copied.
- Inventory: 70 tracked files, including 8 under `app/`, 15 under `tests/`, 15 under `docs/`, and 4 under `results/`. The root `app.py` provides the Gradio workbench; `app/agents.py`, `app/models.py`, `app/utils.py`, `app/run_store.py`, and `app/tools/arxiv_search.py` carry the main runtime. Offline tests exclude `integration` and `network` markers by default; the source CI separately runs a no-key OpenRouter catalog smoke.

## Architecture and inspected areas

- **Scientific cycle:** `SupervisorAgent.run_cycle` executes generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, another ranking, proximity, and meta-review in a fixed order, retaining an in-memory `ContextMemory`. Generation and reflection call an LLM for JSON hypotheses and qualitative novelty/feasibility reviews, but reflection does not verify its requested references. The named pairwise “debate” sums review labels with a random tie break; evolution concatenates the top parents; proximity builds an embedding graph without pruning; meta-review emits generic critiques and fixed next steps. These are implemented but simplified mechanisms, not evidence of the Google system's internals. [Cycle](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L425-L510) · [ranking and evolution](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L138-L198) · [meta-review](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L382-L422).
- **Research and models:** An arXiv tool retrieves papers and aggregates recent category/author counts, but the cycle itself does not consume it; the Gradio UI fetches related papers afterward for display. The user selects an OpenRouter model, and `call_llm` can try up to four dynamic or cached `:free` fallbacks after selected failures. The suffix filter and potentially week-old cache do not verify current pricing or capability, and the selected primary is not price-admitted by this helper. [arXiv tool](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/tools/arxiv_search.py#L206-L247) · [UI use](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L665-L698) · [fallback](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L142-L225) · [dispatch](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L308-L358).
- **Workbench and artifacts:** The root Gradio app collects run settings, runs the cycle in a daemon thread, streams elapsed-time messages, and renders result HTML. It saves one JSON record and generated HTML report per run and offers history and deletion. Cycle logs use a separate relative `results/` path. The five-minute timeout writes a timeout record and ends the UI wait but does not cancel the worker thread. [UI execution](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L315-L383) · [store](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/run_store.py#L88-L175) · [results renderer](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L386-L665).
- **Tests and operations:** The source tests model fallback, JSON parsing/error propagation, arXiv shapes, similarity, Gradio construction/history/timeout, run-store reports, and deployment helper behavior. Its default pytest selection excludes marked live integration and network tests; CI additionally checks public model discovery and boot construction. The Hugging Face deployment path syncs code rather than stored results; no persistent-volume configuration was found in that inspected path. [Test configuration](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/pyproject.toml#L1-L10) · [CI](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L12-L57) · [Space deploy](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/.github/workflows/huggingface-deploy.yml#L102-L121).

## Shipped behavior versus claims

The [README](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/README.md#L96-L111) says repeated cycles build on prior results, but the Gradio click path calls `set_research_goal` each time and resets `global_context`; the interface does not preserve the prior cycle across clicks. The [roadmap](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/docs/plan.md#L5-L15) calls out missing deep verification, debate, diverse evolution, scientific feedback, safety, and asynchronous durable execution; those are plans, not shipped behavior. The timeout message says the app stopped waiting, which is literal: the daemon worker is not cancelled. Upstream tests exercise the display path, but do not prove worker cancellation, consecutive-cycle continuity, tenant isolation, or live-result HTML escaping. The live result renderer interpolates model text into `gr.HTML`, while the saved HTML report has a separate escaping path; the latter's test does not establish safety of the former. [Click handler](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L831-L859) · [context reset](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L147-L184) · [timeout](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L315-L383) · [live renderer](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L630-L638).

## M4 candidate register

All upstream mechanisms here are **external techniques**. A Google-backed requirement is claimed only where the retained [paper corpus](../../docs/CORPUS-EXTRACTION.md) independently supports it. No source code will be copied merely because it has the same agent name.

- **M4-01 — Typed failed-run explanation — adopted for implementation.** Gap: a scientist viewing a failed run may see only internal retry jargon such as `engine.node.generate exhausted its retry budget`, while the useful task-attempt detail remains outside the workbench. LLNL [classifies provider failures](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L46-L67) and [propagates generation errors](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L438-L446). Local `app/app/store/runs_reconcile.py` persists the task cause; `app/frontend/src/workbench/pages/run_detail_shell.tsx` and `run_detail_data.ts` show it verbatim, and the owned `/tasks` endpoint holds attempts. This is an **external technique** adapted independently: persist a structured kind for exact known terminal failures, initially the typed LLM-call ceiling and provider timeout, then show a concise explanation and next step only for failed runs while retaining the recorded technical error. Do not copy LLNL's substring rules (`401`, `404`, `rate limit`, JSON text): they can misclassify unrelated failures; local platform caps are normally parked, not terminal. Acceptance: exact known classes produce stable kinds and matching browser guidance; unknown and near-miss strings stay generic; blocked/cancelled runs receive no provider advice; retry, ownership and recorded detail are unchanged. Boundary: durable task settlement, owned run API, and browser terminal flow. Reuse: independent implementation, no copied code or new dependency. Added inference cost: zero.
- **M4-02 — Five-minute cycle timeout — rejected with evidence.** The user-facing gap would be an indefinitely running research task. LLNL's [Gradio timeout](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L315-L383) returns from the generator and saves a timeout record while its daemon thread continues provider work; its [test](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/tests/test_gradio.py#L169-L198) does not assert cancellation. Local `app/app/runs_lifecycle.py` already revokes queued and leased durable tasks on explicit cancellation, and `task_worker_outcomes.py` parks rate-limit waits instead of consuming retries. The source timeout would report a false stop and risk continued spend, violating the zero-cost and durable-recovery boundaries. Reuse: none. A genuinely durable overall deadline would need its own product criterion and cancellation-race tests; this source does not supply or verify it. Boundary: API lifecycle and durable task recovery. Cost: zero.
- **M4-03 — Cycle files and history — already covered.** LLNL [stores one JSON result and HTML report per cycle](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/run_store.py#L88-L175), with a process-wide history and an unscoped delete action. Local `app/app/store/` persists owned runs, append-only evidence, match/review/task records, and report payloads; `app/app/runs_collections.py` serves owned collections and the React workbench displays the report. Copying the file store would discard ownership, checkpoint and artifact guarantees. Reuse: none. Boundary: ownership, durable execution, report publication. Cost: zero.
- **M4-04 — Dynamic free-suffix fallback — rejected with evidence.** A model unavailable or rate-limited at runtime is a real reliability concern. LLNL's [fallback chain](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L142-L225) can use a week-old cache and its [filter](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L397-L402) admits by `:free` suffix alone. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/llm_free_catalog.py` and `llm_gateway_routing.py` require current exact zero-price eligibility for campaign routing and preserve explicit fallback contracts. Importing suffix-only or stale model admission would weaken the campaign's zero-additional-spend invariant. Reuse: none. Boundary: LLM request admission and retry/fallback. Cost: zero.
- **M4-05 — Hypothesis interchange — rejected as a source adoption.** The gap considered is moving a hypothesis between runs or tools with lineage intact. LLNL's [run record](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/run_store.py#L88-L115) is on-disk JSON, but its Gradio surface offers history and report views, not a hypothesis import/export contract. Local records already expose owned hypotheses with lineage through `app/app/runs_collections.py`; an interchange feature would require an independent schema, provenance and ownership design. There is no source technique to copy or adapt, without claiming the separate feature is unnecessary. Reuse: none. Boundary if proposed independently: API ownership and lineage. Cost: zero.
- **M4-06 — Simplified scientific cycle — already covered.** LLNL's [fixed cycle](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L425-L510), [review-score ranking and text-concatenation evolution](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/agents.py#L138-L198), and generic meta-review offer no demonstrated improvement over local evidence-grounded LangGraph generation, LLM-judged ranking, seven evolution operators, proximity deduplication and research overview. Reuse: none. Boundary: existing engine workflow, ranking and evaluation checks. Cost: zero.
- **M4-07 — Live HTML rendering — rejected source pattern.** LLNL's [live result HTML](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app.py#L630-L638) interpolates model-supplied title/text without escaping, whereas its saved report has a different escaping path. Local React text rendering and Markdown sanitization already protect the report surface (`app/frontend/src/components/markdown_message.tsx` and its tests). Copying the source renderer would introduce an injection risk. Reuse: none. Boundary: browser report rendering. Cost: zero.
- **M4-08 — arXiv activity counts — rejected with evidence.** LLNL's [category/author count helper](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/tools/arxiv_search.py#L206-L247) is uncalled by its cycle or UI; the only trend test checks response shape, not scientific usefulness. Local `engine/src/co_scientist/agents/generation/literature_review/` already uses sourced arXiv retrieval and synthesis rather than popularity counts. There is no observed user or scientific-quality gap for this unintegrated statistic, and it would not establish novelty. Reuse: none. Boundary if proposed with evidence later: frozen paired research-overview/novelty evaluation and source provenance. Cost: zero.
- **M4-09 — BYOK error redaction — adopted and verified locally.** LLNL [replaces its active OpenRouter key in provider errors](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/app/utils.py#L37-L44), with a [synthetic key-echo test](https://github.com/llnl/open-ai-co-scientist/blob/c8342c0e28474d134f80caa6b9668470ebf55258/tests/test_error_propagation.py#L100-L117). Local `app/app/credentials.py::ByokRedactionFilter` formerly protected log records only while a key was scoped, but `app/app/engine_tasks.py::execute_engine_task` exited that scope before the worker recorded/logged `str(exc)`; `store/tasks_attempts.py` and `runs_reconcile.py` then persisted and exposed the error. A provider exception echoing a BYOK key could therefore cross the owned task/run API boundary. This is a conditional code-path risk, not a claim of an observed production leak. Reuse: independently implemented exact active-key redaction at the durable failure boundary and traceback formatters; no copied code. Acceptance: synthetic key-echoing task failure leaks no key through task/run API, attempt history, signed-session event replay, captured logs, JSON stdout, or refresh, while nonsecret diagnostic text, retry count and typed failure kind remain intact. Boundary: durable task execution, owned API/SSE, log capture/output. Cost: zero inference/dependencies. Existing rows are not retroactively scrubbed.

## Evaluation and release evidence

M4-01a completed its backend boundary test-first: the initial owned-run API test failed because `failure_kind` was missing; the final focused lifecycle suite passed (15 tests across the new kind test and existing settlement tests). The terminal status event carries exact `llm_call_budget_exceeded` or `llm_timeout` kind without a database migration, and owned run detail returns it only for a failed run. Unknown and near-miss strings remain unclassified; active sibling work does not cause a premature run-level kind. The recorded technical error and task attempts are unchanged. M4-01b now renders advice for those exact kinds in the existing failed-run page while retaining the recorded error; 24 focused Vitest tests and three isolated browser tests passed, including accessible guidance, reload, blocked and unknown states (cancelled covered in unit tests). M4-09 reproduced a synthetic key echo, then verified redaction through durable errors, signed-session replay, captured logs, and JSON stdout after a reviewer caught the latter bypass; the focused related suites passed. No campaign inference occurred in M4.

The final local release gates passed: `make test-all` (3,144 engine passes/two skips, 1,882 app passes, 283 MCP passes, parity), `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `make build`, `make eval-smoke`, `(cd app/frontend && bun run test --maxWorkers=1)` (738 tests), and `make e2e` (13 tests). The one-worker frontend variant runs the complete suite without concurrent-machine timing interference. No code, dependencies, configuration or evaluation inputs changed after these gates. Scoped cleanup found no scratch product files or duplicate implementation; a report-only UI scan flagged only pre-existing styling lines. No live model call was used because the accepted changes affect failure handling, secret containment and UI guidance rather than scientific output.

PR [#24](https://github.com/guy915/Co-Scientist/pull/24) merged as `8829840ce3f4673f1855ff86dd4c1804fb96aba8`. Hosted GitHub Actions stopped at its initial target-selection job under the known account hold and skipped the actual test jobs; the user's explicit waiver applied to hosted CI only. Railway API deployment `0f056663-ae7e-4e27-9494-161b0dcf6d00` and MCP deployment `04c0dd0c-e9ef-4e3f-a753-fab55291881c` each reported SUCCESS on that commit. Vercel production deployment `dpl_4nizDgGjoJyCVhRESiY7jmFYnC5y` reported READY, aliased to `ai-co-scientist.com`, with the same Git commit. The API service still has one replica and its persistent `/app/data` volume; no configuration or schema change was made for M4. Railway's rendered-variable CLI read was rejected by automatic approval review, so current variable *values* were not independently read back; service configuration exposed only names and the unchanged source/replica/volume settings.

The non-mutating production smoke passed health, MCP availability, ownership isolation, CORS and sanitized-share checks. A signed campaign-owned session reopened existing public-goal run `1c33deee-e0c0-4a9b-b9a0-48e88076fe03` and observed the deployed `failure_kind` field plus event replay, without starting inference. That historical run is cancelled, so this read does not prove a new typed terminal failure or a completed scientific report in production; the synthetic failure and UI states were verified through the local API and isolated browser boundaries. The clean pinned source checkout was removed. No additional spending occurred.
